|lore=Stormtrooper utility belts contain basic tools such as a grappling hook to grab onto protrusions. The hook can also be used to ensnare escaping targets.
|game_text=If less than three Grappling Hooks on table and opponent just played an interrupt, use 1 Force to deploy on table to stack that card here. Other copies of that card are destiny -3. [Immune to Control]

|notes=The 2006 slip phrases the three-Grappling-Hook limit as an exception to the Interrupt response. The [[Grappling Hook (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution) (Original)|original-edition slip]] survives in the consolidated PDF made in February 2003. The sheet gives 20 September 2002 as the set’s tournament-legality date, and the complete set was available by 21 September. The [[Grappling Hook (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution) (Remastered 2006)|2006 publication]] gives its text as of 4 December 2006.
